modes.title: Modes
modes.createModeHelpText: Modes are specialized personas that tailor Bro's behavior. <0>Learn about Using Modes</0> or <1>Customizing Modes.</1>

configurationSet.title: Configuration Set
configurationSet.description: A named mode→provider mapping. Switch sets to change which provider every mode uses at once, e.g. "Cheap" vs "Best Quality".
configurationSet.select: Select which configuration set is active
configurationSet.cannotDeleteOnlySet: Cannot delete the only configuration set
configurationSet.seedFromCurrent: Start from the active set's mappings
configurationSet.nameExists: A configuration set with this name already exists

apiConfiguration.title: API Configuration
apiConfiguration.select: Select which API configuration to use for this mode

fallbackApiConfiguration.title: Fallback API Providers
fallbackApiConfiguration.description: Backup API profiles this mode fails over to, in order, when its primary provider keeps hitting transient errors (rate limits, 5xx, network failures). Each is tried once after same-profile retries are exhausted.
fallbackApiConfiguration.maxDescription: The maximum number of fallback providers you can add to any single mode.
fallbackApiConfiguration.empty: No fallbacks configured — this mode uses only its primary profile.
fallbackApiConfiguration.builtInHint: Fallbacks can only be set on custom modes. Duplicate this built-in mode first, then configure fallbacks on the copy.
fallbackApiConfiguration.capReached: You've reached the maximum number of fallbacks for a mode.
fallbackApiConfiguration.noProfilesLeft: All available provider profiles are already in this chain.

errorRepairApiConfiguration.title: Error-Repair Helper LLM
errorRepairApiConfiguration.description: When the main model produces a malformed tool call, this profile is used to silently repair and execute just that call before it's reported back as an error.

tools.title: Available Tools
tools.builtInModesText: Tools for built-in modes cannot be modified

roleDefinition.title: Role Definition
roleDefinition.description: Define Bro's expertise and personality for this mode. This description shapes how Bro presents itself and approaches tasks.

description.title: Short description (for humans)
description.description: A brief description shown in the mode selector dropdown.

whenToUse.title: When to Use (optional)
whenToUse.description: Guidance for Bro for when this mode should be used. This helps the Orchestrator choose the right mode for a task.
whenToUse.resetToDefault: Reset to default 'When to Use' description

includeInSystemPrompt.title: Present to common SYSTEM PROMPT
includeInSystemPrompt.description: When enabled, this mode is listed in the MODES section of the system prompt so other modes (like Orchestrator) know it exists. Disable this to keep the mode usable while hiding it from that list.

customInstructions.title: Mode-specific Custom Instructions (optional)
customInstructions.description: Add behavioral guidelines specific to {{modeName}} mode.
customInstructions.loadFromFile: Custom instructions specific to {{mode}} mode can also be loaded from the .bro/rules-{{slug}}/ folder in your workspace or from the global <0>.bro/rules-{{slug}}/ (.brorules-{{slug}} and .clinerules-{{slug}} are deprecated and will stop working soon).

exportMode.title: Export Mode
exportMode.description: Export this mode with rules from the .bro/rules-{{slug}}/ folder combined into a shareable YAML file. The original files remain unchanged.

importMode.selectLevel: Choose where to import this mode:

global.label: Global Level
global.description: Available across all projects. If the exported mode contained rules files, they will be recreated in the global .bro/rules-{slug}/ folder.

project.label: Project Level
project.description: Only available in this workspace. If the exported mode contained rules files, they will be recreated in .bro/rules-{slug}/ folder.

globalCustomInstructions.title: Custom Instructions for All Modes
globalCustomInstructions.description: These instructions apply to all modes. They provide a base set of behaviors that can be enhanced by mode-specific instructions below. <0>Learn more</0>
globalCustomInstructions.loadFromFile: Instructions can also be loaded from the .bro/rules/ folder in your workspace or from the global <0>.bro/rules/ (.brorules and .clinerules are deprecated and will stop working soon).

enhance.apiConfigDescription: You can select an API configuration to always use for enhancing prompts, or just use whatever is currently selected
enhance.testPromptPlaceholder: Enter a prompt to test the enhancement
enhance.includeTaskHistoryDescription: When enabled, the last 10 messages from the current conversation will be included as context when enhancing prompts, helping to generate more relevant and context-aware suggestions.

condense.apiConfigDescription: Select which API configuration to use for context condensing operations. Leave unselected to use the current active configuration.

ENHANCE.label: Enhance Prompt
ENHANCE.description: Use prompt enhancement to get tailored suggestions or improvements for your inputs. This ensures Bro understands your intent and provides the best possible responses. Available via the ✨ icon in chat.

CONDENSE.label: Context Condensing
CONDENSE.description: Configure how conversation context is condensed to manage token limits. This prompt is used for both manual and automatic context condensing operations.

EXPLAIN.label: Explain Code
EXPLAIN.description: Get detailed explanations of code snippets, functions, or entire files. Useful for understanding complex code or learning new patterns. Available in code actions (lightbulb icon in the editor) and the editor context menu (right-click on selected code).

FIX.label: Fix Issues
FIX.description: Get help identifying and resolving bugs, errors, or code quality issues. Provides step-by-step guidance for fixing problems. Available in code actions (lightbulb icon in the editor) and the editor context menu (right-click on selected code).

IMPROVE.label: Improve Code
IMPROVE.description: Receive suggestions for code optimization, better practices, and architectural improvements while maintaining functionality. Available in code actions (lightbulb icon in the editor) and the editor context menu (right-click on selected code).

ADD_TO_CONTEXT.label: Add to Context
ADD_TO_CONTEXT.description: Add context to your current task or conversation. Useful for providing additional information or clarifications. Available in code actions (lightbulb icon in the editor) and the editor context menu (right-click on selected code).

TERMINAL_ADD_TO_CONTEXT.label: Add Terminal Content to Context
TERMINAL_ADD_TO_CONTEXT.description: Add terminal output to your current task or conversation. Useful for providing command outputs or logs. Available in the terminal context menu (right-click on selected terminal content).

TERMINAL_FIX.label: Fix Terminal Command
TERMINAL_FIX.description: Get help fixing terminal commands that failed or need improvement. Available in the terminal context menu (right-click on selected terminal content).

TERMINAL_EXPLAIN.label: Explain Terminal Command
TERMINAL_EXPLAIN.description: Get detailed explanations of terminal commands and their outputs. Available in the terminal context menu (right-click on selected terminal content).

NEW_TASK.label: Start New Task
NEW_TASK.description: Start a new task with user input. Available in the Command Palette.

slug.label: Slug
slug.description: The slug is used in URLs and file names. It should be lowercase and contain only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

saveLocation.label: Save Location
saveLocation.description: Choose where to save this mode. Project-specific modes take precedence over global modes.

project.label: Project-specific (.bromodes)
project.description: Only available in this workspace, takes precedence over global

roleDefinition.label: Role Definition
roleDefinition.description: Define Bro's expertise and personality for this mode.

description.label: Short description (for humans)
description.description: A brief description shown in the mode selector dropdown.

whenToUse.label: When to Use (optional)
whenToUse.description: Guidance for Bro for when this mode should be used. This helps the Orchestrator choose the right mode for a task.

tools.label: Available Tools
tools.description: Select which tools this mode can use.

customInstructions.label: Custom Instructions (optional)
customInstructions.description: Add behavioral guidelines specific to this mode.

deleteMode.title: Delete Mode
deleteMode.message: Are you sure you want to delete the mode "{{modeName}}"?
deleteMode.rulesFolder: This mode has a rules folder at {{folderPath}} that will also be deleted.
deleteMode.descriptionNoRules: Are you sure you want to delete this custom mode?
